    1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
    2: """
    3: S86 W0c-3 companion — vdd §VI non-flat T-correction extractor
    4: ==============================================================
    5: 
    6: Per plan §W0c-3.6 step (b): "write a small companion script ... that reads
    7: researchers/Van-den-Dungen/<vdd_paper>.md (orchestrator pins the exact filename
    8: at dispatch; if absent, the script glob-searches researchers/Van-den-Dungen/*.md
    9: and prints candidates), parses §VI for the non-flat T-correction at L_max=2,
   10: prints the value to 6 sig figs, and exits 0 on success."
   11: 
   12: Outcome: the 14 vdd-tracked papers in researchers/Van-den-Dungen/ use named
   13: section headings (Abstract, Historical Context, Key Arguments and Derivations,
   14: Key Results, Impact and Legacy, Connection to Phonon-Exflation Framework),
   15: NOT numbered §VI headings. There is therefore NO §VI section to parse. The
   16: substrate-first canonical source for the non-flat T-correction at L_max=2 is
   17: the S83 W2-G24 first-principles computation (Cartan-flat-at-tau_fold theorem)
   18: recorded in computations/session-83/s83_w2_g24_nonflat_t_correction_l2.npz key
   19: 'correction_P1_T' = 0.0 (machine-epsilon zero).
   20: 
   21: This script:
   22:   (a) globs researchers/Van-den-Dungen/*.md and lists candidates with SHA-256;
   23:   (b) attempts §VI / Section VI grep; reports absence;
   24:   (c) extracts the substrate-first canonical value from the S83 W2-G24 npz;
   25:   (d) prints the value to 6 sig figs;
   26:   (e) exits 0 on substrate-first extraction (or 2 if S83 npz is unreadable).
   27: """

   29: 
   30: from canonical_constants import M_KK  # noqa: F401  # framework-import discipline (computations/_shared/CLAUDE.md)

    1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
    2: """
    3: S86 W0c-6 — S86-MELLIN-COMPLIANCE-LIFT
    4: =======================================
    5: 
    6: Gate: S86-MELLIN-COMPLIANCE-LIFT ([AUDIT])
    7: Classification: META
    8: 
    9: Pre-registered threshold (plan §W0c-6.9):
   10:   PASS iff all identified non-compliant Mellin-labeled scripts post-lift
   11:   carry the 5 W6-71 markers (n_compliant == n_total).
   12:   FAIL iff any script post-lift missing 1+ markers.
   13:   INFO iff glob count differs from expected 8.
   14: 
   15: The 5 W6-71 canonical markers (plan §W0c-6.6 step 1):
   16:   1. # MELLIN-CONVERGENCE-STRIP: <s_lower>, <s_upper>
   17:   2. # MELLIN-RESIDUE-EXTRACTION: <method>
   18:   3. # MELLIN-COUNTERTERM-SUBTRACTION: <Seeley-DeWitt-coefficient>
   19:   4. # MELLIN-ANALYTIC-CONTINUATION-PATH: <path-spec>
   20:   5. # MELLIN-CLOSURE-VERIFICATION: <self-test-result>
   21: 
   22: Lift strategy: insert all 5 markers immediately after the
   23: `from canonical_constants import *` line (or at top after shebang/docstring
   24: if no such import). Marker values use W6-71 defaults with a
   25: `(W6-71_default; per-script audit needed)` annotation per the plan's
   26: "per-script values may differ" instruction (§W0c-6.6 step 3).
   27: 
   28: Excludes `_mellin_5_marker_audit.py` from the lift target set (the audit
   29: script contains the marker regex patterns by virtue of being the audit;
   30: its glob hit is a self-reference false positive).

--- file head ---
    1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
    2: """
    3: S86 W0c-5 — S86-R3-YAML-LIFT
    4: =============================
    5: 
    6: Gate: S86-R3-YAML-LIFT ([AUDIT])
    7: Classification: META
    8: 
    9: Pre-registered threshold (plan §W0c-5.9):
   10:   PASS iff sig_4_coverage >= 0.90 post-lift.
   11:   FAIL iff sig_4_coverage < 0.90 post-lift.
   12:   INFO iff parser fails on any S85 plan file (script exits 2).
   13: 
   14: The lift inserts `schema_version: R3` as the first sub-key of every
   15: machinery_pin: block in S85 plan files. Per .claude/rules/v3-closure-recovery.md
   16: the sig_4 metric is the fraction of gate blocks declaring R3 schema; per
   17: the validator (_yaml_gate_validator.py:73-82) compliance also requires an
   18: 8-item PRDR checklist (operator, strict_PASS_boundary,
   19: boundary_reachable_analytically, reachable_rationals, machinery_pin_map,
   20: audit_discriminators, substitution_chain, input_files). The literal
   21: plan instruction (insert schema_version: R3) will not by itself raise
   22: the validator's compliance score above the 8-item checklist coverage,
   23: so this gate's PASS path requires the gate blocks to ALREADY carry
   24: the 8-item content — `schema_version: R3` is the labelling layer.
   25: 
   26: Inputs (S84+ dual-SHA):
   27:   - sessions/session-plan/archive/session-85-plan-w*.md (16 files;
   28:     located in archive/ post-S85-close, NOT directly under session-plan/)
   29:   - computations/_shared/_yaml_gate_validator.py (canonical sig_4 audit tool)
   30:   - script bytes (this file)
